description: Convert a word count, or a pasted script, into a spoken runtime range, and convert a target runtime back into a word budget. Rates come from Prepublish's own measurement of 349 videos: 25th percentile 160 words per minute, median 181, 75th percentile 201. Choose this for "how long will this script run" or "how many words for a ten-minute video". It is arithmetic on speaking rate only: it excludes pauses, B-roll and demonstrations, so a finished edit usually runs longer.

script_text.description: A script to count. Provide this or word_count or target_minutes.

target_minutes.description: A target runtime in minutes, to convert into a word budget.

word_count.description: A word count, if the user already knows it.

name: script_runtime

caveat.description: What this arithmetic excludes. Repeat it rather than presenting a single number.

runtime_minutes.description: Spoken runtime in minutes at each rate. Present when script_text or word_count was given.

source.description: Where the rates come from, with the published write-up.

speaking_rates_words_per_minute.description: The measured rates used, in words per minute: slow is the 25th percentile, median the 50th, fast the 75th.

target_minutes.description: The target runtime asked for, echoed back. Present when target_minutes was given.

word_budget.description: Words needed to fill the target at each rate. Present when target_minutes was given.

fast.description: Word budget at the fast rate.

median.description: Word budget at the median rate.

slow.description: Word budget at the slow rate.

word_count.description: Words counted or supplied. Present when script_text or word_count was given.

title: Convert script length to spoken runtime
